[[File:Dragonstone detail.png|left|130px]]
'''Dragonstones''' are rare [[gems]] which can be cut from [[uncut dragonstone]]s, requiring 55 [[Crafting]] and yielding 137.5 [[experience]]. It can then be made into dragonstone [[jewellery]] by using a [[furnace]] along with a [[gold bar]] and a [[mould]].

[[Monster]]s with access to the [[rare drop table]] have a chance to drop cut dragonstones.

[[Dragonstone (Mage Training Arena)|Dragonstone]]s from the [[Mage Training Arena]] [[minigame]] are different, providing [[pizazz points]] when [[enchantment spells]] are used on them and they cannot be taken outside the [[Mage Training Arena#Enchanting Chamber|enchanting chamber]].

5 dragonstones can be given to [[Olbertus]] in the [[Forthos Dungeon]] to receive a [[temple coin]] and unlock the [[Sacred Bone Burner]].

===Magic===
Dragonstone jewellery is enchanted using [[Lvl-5 Enchant]], requiring 68 [[Magic]], 1 [[cosmic rune]], 15 [[earth rune]]s, 15 [[water rune]]s along with the piece of dragonstone [[jewellery]]. Charged dragonstone jewellery is some of the few usable [[teleportation]] methods beyond level 20 up to level 30 [[Wilderness]] along with the [[Pharaoh's sceptre]], [[grand seed pod]], [[royal seed pod]], [[slayer ring]] and [[ring of life]].

==Trivia==
* When attempting to cut a dragonstone, the option to stop cutting the dragonstone into tips is "No! Don't cut my lovely dragonstone!"
**If the dragonstone is left intact, the player will receive a chatbox message: {{mes|You carefully take the chisel away from the expensive dragonstone.}}
* Dragonstone was used as one of the tiers of post count badges on the [[RuneScape Forums|official Runescape Forums]]. Players had to have made 500,000 posts to be given the dragonstone badge.
